hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qE '[^[:alnum:]]git[[:space:]]+push([^[:alnum:]]|$)'; then ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null); if [ -d "$ROOT/.github/workflows" ] || [ -f "$ROOT/.gitlab-ci.yml" ]; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","additionalContext":"This repo has CI workflows and a git push is about to run. Validate them locally with the wrkflw skill (wrkflw validate) before pushing."}}'; fi; fi
hooks.description: Remind to validate workflows with wrkflw before git push

hooks.command: INPUT=$(cat); if echo "$INPUT" | grep -qF '[plan-reviewed-by-agents:'; then exit 0; else printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Before submitting this plan, have agents review it. 1) Dispatch at least one review agent (e.g. the built-in general-purpose agent via the Task tool, or any code-review agent you have installed) to critique the plan for gaps, bugs, and wrong assumptions. 2) Incorporate the findings into the plan. 3) Append a final line to the plan, filling in the blanks: [plan-reviewed-by-agents: AGENT_NAME_HERE; SUMMARY_HERE] (replace AGENT_NAME_HERE with the agent type(s) you used, and SUMMARY_HERE with a short summary or the phrase no blocking issues). 4) Re-call ExitPlanMode with the updated plan text (the marker must be in the plan argument, not only the plan file). If agents already reviewed this plan, just add that filled-in marker line and resubmit."}}'; fi
hooks.description: Require agent review of a plan before ExitPlanMode (bypass via [plan-reviewed-by-agents:] marker)
